## 🔍 Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New user-facing feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests
- [ ] `refactor`: Internal code refactoring
- [ ] `chore`: CI/CD, build, or tooling update

---

## ✅ Agile Pre-Flight Checklist
- [ ] Change is atomic (addresses one single issue without mixing unrelated scopes).
- [ ] Commits adhere to Conventional Commits: `type(scope): description (fixes #XX)`.
- [ ] Local tests pass cleanly: `python -m unittest tests/test_website.py`.
- [ ] Target branch is correct:
  - Targeting `qa` for feature/fix integration.
  - Targeting `main` for QA-to-Production promotion.
